ash: Heads-up: Marketplace reseller NimbusCloud onboarding next week. They sent a projection ~60k GPU-hours over first 30 days. Need a provisioning + network/egress plan. cc @partners-team

morgan: Do we have a regional split or is that total only?

ash: They only gave totals. Verbal split: ~60% US, 30% EU, 10% APAC. They warned traffic will be bursty — daily peaks ~3x baseline.

felipe: Quick back-of-envelope — 3x burst means we need reserved baseline + spot buffer. Will check our current pools.

capacity-bot: Snapshot: us-west reserved=180 GPUs (70% used), eu-west reserved=80 GPUs (65% used), apac-sg reserved=40 GPUs (50% used). Spot avail: us-west=high, eu-west=medium, apac=low. Avg queue depth=12, p95 latency=210ms.

ria: Major concern: marketplace routing increases egress and cross-region hops. We must confirm whether NimbusCloud will accept pass-through of egress charges or if we absorb. @cira FYI.

cira: Finance quick take: incremental egress + reserved provisioning at projected utilization ~ $45k/mo. Need reseller contract terms to cover thresholds or we should add a surcharge.

ash: Proposed plan:
- Reserve +50 GPUs in us-west, +30 in eu-west for initial 60 days.
- Autoscale with spot backfill up to +150 GPUs in us-west during peaks.
- Canary rollout: 5% traffic for 48h -> 25% for 7d -> full.
- Instrument: per-route token counters, billing hooks, per-request region tag.

felipe: I'll open an infra ticket and add a canary playbook. Also need a network runbook to avoid cross-AZ egress surprises. Suggest model routing fallback to a quantized variant if latency budget allows.

ash: quick capacity calc snippet for baseline:
```python
sessions = 1200
avg_gpu_seconds = 40  # avg GPU sec per session
daily_gpu_hours = sessions * avg_gpu_seconds / 3600
print(daily_gpu_hours)  # ~13.3 GPU-hrs baseline, times 3 = ~40
```

morgan: That avg looks optimistic. Use avg_gpu_seconds=300 -> daily ~100 GPU-hrs -> peak ~300 -> concurrent need ~200 GPUs during 8h peak.

felipe: Noted. If peak window is 8h, reserving ~250 GPUs in us-west is safer. Will update ticket.

ria: Ops question: can we tag per-request so billing attribution is automatic to the marketplace/reseller account? RDW-telemetry should support it but needs mapping table.

cira: Finance: yes, but we need partner order IDs mapped to internal account IDs. Sales/legal to provide mapping and surcharge language.

ash: Action items:
- felipe: open INFRA ticket with region/reserve numbers + canary playbook and network runbook (Due EOD).
- morgan: run revised capacity calc + cost sim with avg 300s and peak profile (Due tomorrow).
- ria: coordinate with sales for mapping table + legal for surcharge language (Due Thu).
- cira: produce cost estimate doc with thresholds and link to billing hooks (Due Fri).

felipe: Creating ticket INFRA-6732 — will paste canary playbook and k8s scaling snippet there.
